verdict.rationale: Box's developer guides document creating shared links through the API, including an example of creating an open shared link on a file, and say links come with configurable access levels, which covers the visibility part of the story. Password protection, expiry dates and revoking links are not mentioned anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented password setting, expiry setting, link revocation/removal via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, sharing is programmable — shared links with visibility, password, and expiry settings can be created and revoked via the API

citations.quote: Create an open shared link on a file:
Generate URL-based access to files, folders, and web links stored in Box with configurable access levels.
Shared links are URLs that are generated for files, folders, web links stored in Box, which provide direct, read-only access to the resource.
